settings.label: HIGH_ENCRYPTION

settings.description: Select how the built-in WiFi card is used. OFF disables WiFi entirely, HOTSPOT enables the access point for nearby devices, and CLIENT connects the unit to an existing WiFi network.
settings.label: WIFI_MODE

settings.description: Enable/Disable WiFi hotspot such that you can connect to your air/ground unit via normal WiFi. Frequency is always the opposite of your WB link, e.g. 2.4G if your wb link is 5.8G and opposite. In AUTO (default), the wifi hotspot is automatically disarmed when you arm your FC (to avoid interference).
settings.label: WIFI_HOTSPOT_E

settings.description: Comma separated list of detected WiFi interfaces and their current roles (wb/hotspot/client/idle).

settings.label: WIFI_HS_IFACE

settings.description: Optional interface to use for WiFi client mode (empty = auto). Only applied when WiFi mode is set to CLIENT.

Requires reboot.
settings.label: ETH_HOTSPOT_E

settings.description: Enable automatic video & telemetry forwarding via ethernet if EITH_HOTSPOT_E is false (Recommended).Cannot be used simultaneously with ETH_HOTSPOT_E. Doesn't require reboot.

settings.description: Specify the intended usage of the ground station ethernet port (for connecting external devices). A reboot might be required after changing this param.

settings.description: Enable mavlink telemetry out via UART on the ground station for connecting a tracker or even an RC with mavlink lua script.
settings.label: TRACKER_UART_OUT

settings.description: UART device used as the full bidirectional OpenHD telemetry link between Air and Ground. Configure the corresponding device on both units.
settings.label: OHD_UART_TLM

settings.description: Change which joystick 'channel' is taken for each RC channel. This is a list of numbers, where each number X at position N means take joystick input nr X for channel N. For example, 1,4,... means take channel number 1 for the first channel, and channel number 4 for the second channel. Needs to have ! all! 18 channel elements seperated by a ','
settings.label: RC_CHAN_MAP

settings.description: Infiray thermal colors
settings.label: COLOR_PALETE

settings.description: Specify the update rate of RC over wifibroadcast. A higher update rate gives lower RC latency, but takes more bandwidth away from the downlink.No effect if joy rc is disabled.
settings.label: RC_UPDATE_HZ

settings.description: enables / disables audio streaming from air to ground. In development. Use test mode to validate your ground audio output.
settings.label: AUDIO_ENABLE
System role
settings.description: Air, Ground, or record-only mode. Applies when OpenHD restarts.

settings.label: System debug logging
settings.description: Enable or disable SysUtils debug logging.

settings.label: Force display mode
settings.description: Enable the configured display mode, or restore automatic mode selection after reboot.

settings.label: Forced display resolution and refresh rate
settings.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT@HZ, for example 1920x1080@60. Applying a mode also enables forced display mode. Requires reboot.

settings.label: Arducam sensor mode
settings.description: Select experimental three-exposure full-field binned HDR. HDR uses 30 fps and manual exposure; 120 dB has not been measured end-to-end.

settings.label: ISP exposure mode
settings.description: Automatic shutter and gain are the default in standard video modes, including 720p120. Manual controls remain available. Experimental HDR requires Manual. Applies live; switching to the custom manual 120 fps readout may briefly pause video.

settings.label: Auto exposure profile
settings.description: Normal: native automatic exposure. Sport: native Sports scene and a 2 ms shutter cap to reduce motion blur. Fly: 4 ms shutter cap, native backlight scene and lower-image exposure feedback, allowing a bright sky to clip. Fly is experimental and awaits outdoor validation. Profiles apply live without restarting capture; retained while Manual is selected.

settings.label: ISP exposure (us)
settings.description: Manual ISP shutter request in microseconds; applies live. This experimental profile limits exposure to 4 ms.

settings.label: ISP gain (%)
settings.description: Manual ISP gain, 100 percent is unity. Applies live without restarting video.

settings.label: Automatic white balance
settings.description: Enable ISP automatic white balance. Disable to apply the saved manual Kelvin temperature.

settings.label: Color temperature (K)
settings.description: Manual ISP white-balance temperature in Kelvin, active while automatic white balance is off.

settings.label: ISP gamma (%)
settings.description: ISP gamma control: zero selects sRGB; other values are percentages of S3.12 unity. Applies live.

settings.label: Arducam HDR status
settings.description: HDR implementation and validation limits supplied by the camera backend.

imageWriter._comment: Machine-readable map of OpenHD advanced options, the UI categories that show them, and the FAT32 outputs written by downloadthread.cpp.
imageWriter._comment_use: Programs can traverse each setting object to build menus and know which file/value is produced.

useSettings._comment: Global gate: when true, all other files under openhd/ are written.

files.note: All other setting files are only written when useSettings is true.

bootType._comment: Mutually exclusive Air/Ground flags that create marker files.

sbc._comment: Detected SBC marker files written as empty files.

camera._comment: Camera selection depends on SBC and vendor/category shown in the UI.
camera.valueEncoding: stringified OpenHD camera type integers written to openhd/settings.json

cameraResolution._comment: Resolution/fps choices keyed by OpenHD camera type value (widthxheight@fps).
cameraResolution.valueEncoding: string written to openhd/settings.json as camera_resolution_fps and camera2_resolution_fps

ipCamera._comment: Shown when primary or secondary camera type 3 (IP-CAMERA) is selected. Values are imported by openhd-sysutils and used as OpenHD's initial camera configuration.

rpi5CameraConnectors._comment: For Raspberry Pi CSI cameras, ImageWriter asks which Pi 5 connector is used. Sysutils applies ,cam0 for CAM0; CAM1 uses the overlay default.

groundDisplay._comment: Optional forced HDMI mode. Sysutils applies it to the DRM boot argument and OpenHD Glide, then reboots. Omit or set display_force_mode=false to retain automatic EDID mode selection.

qopenhdConf._comment: Optional full configuration file copied verbatim when provided by the user.

mapboxApiKey._comment: Optional Mapbox public access token. OpenHD SysUtils imports it into QOpenHD's map_api_key setting on first boot.

premiumCertificate._comment: Optional signed premium certificate copied verbatim when provided by the user.

hotSpot._comment: UI exposes WifiHotspot but creation of wifi_hotspot.txt is commented out in downloadthread.cpp.

beep._comment: Stored in settings but not written to FAT32 partition.

eject._comment: Stored in settings but not written to FAT32 partition.

wifi_hotspot_mode.label: WiFi hotspot mode
wifi_hotspot_mode.description: Control whether the OpenHD hotspot is managed automatically, forced off or always on.

wifi_hotspot_interface_override.label: WiFi hotspot interface override
wifi_hotspot_interface_override.description: Optional interface name to force for hotspot mode (leave blank for auto).

wifi_hotspot_ssid.label: WiFi hotspot SSID
wifi_hotspot_ssid.description: Override the default OpenHD hotspot SSID (blank uses the unit name).

wifi_hotspot_password.label: WiFi hotspot password
wifi_hotspot_password.description: Override the default hotspot password (8–63 chars; blank uses default).

ethernet_operating_mode.label: Ethernet operating mode
ethernet_operating_mode.description: Choose how OpenHD configures the ethernet port (untouched, hotspot or forwarding).

fc_uart_connection_type.label: Flight controller UART port
fc_uart_connection_type.description: Select which serial device OpenHD should use to communicate with the flight controller. "DEFAULT" resolves to the recommended port for the current platform.

fc_uart_baudrate.label: UART baud rate
fc_uart_baudrate.description: Allowed values follow the Linux serial driver (9 600 – 1 000 000 baud).

fc_uart_flow_control.label: Hardware flow control (RTS/CTS)
fc_uart_flow_control.description: Enable RTS/CTS flow control for flight-controller serial links that support it.

fc_battery_n_cells.label: Battery cell count
fc_battery_n_cells.description: Set the number of cells reported by the flight controller (0 leaves it unset).

primary_camera_type.label: Primary camera type
primary_camera_type.description: Matches the camera enumeration used by OpenHD (camera.hpp).

secondary_camera_type.label: Secondary camera type
secondary_camera_type.description: Set to "Disabled" to keep the secondary stream inactive.

switch_primary_and_secondary.label: Swap primary and secondary inputs
switch_primary_and_secondary.description: Swap detected camera order when the hardware enumeration is inverted.

dualcam_primary_video_allocated_bandwidt.label: Primary camera bandwidth share (%)
dualcam_primary_video_allocated_bandwidt.description: Allocate bitrate between primary and secondary streams (10% – 90%).

ip_camera_bitrate_mbits.label: IP camera reservation
ip_camera_bitrate_mbits.description: Fixed link rate reserved for an IP camera in either slot. OpenHD cannot adjust its encoder; configure the camera itself at or below this value and keep it low.

enable_audio.label: Audio capture mode
enable_audio.description: Enable real audio capture or run the encoder test tone.

ip_camera_address.label: Camera IPv4 address
ip_camera_address.description: Address configured on the IP camera. OpenHD adds a secondary local /24 address when needed without replacing the normal Ethernet configuration.

ip_camera_pipeline.label: Managed GStreamer source pipeline
ip_camera_pipeline.description: Maximum 127 characters. Use {IP} for the configured camera address. Must output elementary H264/H265 matching the selected codec. Saving requires an OpenHD restart when editing this file directly.

ip_camera_address.label: Camera IPv4 address
ip_camera_address.description: Address configured on the IP camera. OpenHD adds a secondary local /24 address when needed without replacing the normal Ethernet configuration.

ip_camera_pipeline.label: Managed GStreamer source pipeline
ip_camera_pipeline.description: Maximum 127 characters. Use {IP} for the configured camera address. Must output elementary H264/H265 matching the selected codec. Saving requires an OpenHD restart when editing this file directly.

wb_frequency.label: Center frequency (MHz)
wb_frequency.description: Must be a supported WiFi channel frequency. OpenHD validates against the card capabilities.

wb_air_tx_channel_width.label: Channel width (MHz)
wb_air_tx_channel_width.description: Valid channel widths are 10 or 20 MHz.

wb_air_mcs_index.label: Air unit MCS index
wb_air_mcs_index.description: 0 – 31 per validate_settings_helper.h; lower values trade throughput for range.

wb_enable_stbc.label: Enable STBC
wb_enable_stbc.description: Space-time block coding can improve diversity on multi-antenna hardware.

wb_enable_ldpc.label: Enable LDPC
wb_enable_ldpc.description: Turn on low-density parity-check coding when supported by your radios.

wb_enable_short_guard.label: Use short guard interval
wb_enable_short_guard.description: Short guard intervals slightly reduce robustness but increase throughput.

enable_wb_video_variable_bitrate.label: Allow variable encoder bitrate
enable_wb_video_variable_bitrate.description: Let the link dynamically request lower encoder bitrates on poor links.

wb_tx_power_milli_watt_armed.label: TX power when armed (mW)
wb_tx_power_milli_watt_armed.description: Override transmit power when the vehicle is armed (0 keeps the default).

wb_rtl8812au_tx_pwr_idx_override_armed.label: RTL8812AU TX power index when armed
wb_rtl8812au_tx_pwr_idx_override_armed.description: Set to 0 to keep the default armed power index.

wb_video_rate_for_mcs_adjustment_percent.label: Rate reduction for MCS (%)
wb_video_rate_for_mcs_adjustment_percent.description: Reduce encoder bitrate relative to theoretical maximum (10 – 200%).

wb_max_fec_block_size.label: Max FEC block size
wb_max_fec_block_size.description: 0 enables automatic sizing, positive values clamp the block size. -1 keeps the platform default.

wb_qp_min.label: Encoder QP minimum
wb_qp_min.description: Lower values improve quality but need more bandwidth (typical range 10 – 45).

wb_qp_max.label: Encoder QP maximum
wb_qp_max.description: Higher values allow more compression at the cost of quality.

wb_mcs_index_via_rc_channel.label: RC channel for MCS control
wb_mcs_index_via_rc_channel.description: 0 disables RC control. Otherwise set the RC channel index that should modify MCS.

wb_bw_via_rc_channel.label: RC channel for bandwidth control
wb_bw_via_rc_channel.description: 0 disables RC control. Otherwise choose the RC channel used for bandwidth switching.

wb_enable_listen_only_mode.label: Listen-only mode
wb_enable_listen_only_mode.description: Enable passive reception without transmitting (developer/diagnostic use).

wb_dev_air_set_high_retransmit_count.label: High retransmit count (developer)
wb_dev_air_set_high_retransmit_count.description: Developer option to raise WiFi retransmit thresholds.
